ambiguity_resolutions.question: What is approved before the review-required toric scaling contract can execute?
ambiguity_resolutions.resolution: Approve only a one-map derivation gate on one m=3 fixture, including the rational inverse, denominator and exceptional ideals, saturated mixed volumes, and exhaustive source preservation.

ambiguity_resolutions.question: How is post-hoc map selection prevented?
ambiguity_resolutions.resolution: Use the contract's frozen shortlex degree-bounded Cremona grammar and retain every enumerated map; the first map passing all Phase 1 gates is the only selectable candidate.
